question: Starting from the contracting iterative-shift seeds, can a generated pose reach exact static feasibility? Phase 1 descends the passive-subsystem scaled balance error over every non-root DOF (actuated and passive) under the saved contact map, tendon map and friction while only the bias target is recomputed; phase 2 re-derives contacts and runs the unchanged gate chain on the terminal poses.
hypothesis: If the fixed-geometry residual has a nonzero floor, the contact configuration itself (not pose choice within it) is the binding constraint; if descent reaches ~0 but physical certification fails, the gap is the fixed-map approximation and a contact-aware generator is needed.
units: Native MuJoCo model units; residual R is dimensionless (scaled balance error)
controls: phase 1 holds the seed's saved contact map, tendon map, friction and tension limits fixed; only qfrc_bias - qfrc_passive is recomputed at each trial pose
every accepted descent step saves its qpos and target so the verifier replays LPs on saved arrays without any physics
phase 2 re-derives contact heights, contacts, tendon limits and audits at the generated pose with the unchanged gate chain and solver
an undecided LP is recorded as unresolved, never as physical infeasibility
no actuator, controller, CNS or dynamic trial is executed
success_criterion: Every declared seed executes its descent within the eval/wall budgets; each terminal and midpoint pose is physically certified through the full gate chain; all saved LPs replay under the verifier; the aggregate outcome follows the declared rules.
falsification: A certified 'feasible' passive subsystem rejects 'this contact family cannot support the model'; a certified full-support 'feasible' rejects the static-support deficit outright. Nonzero fixed-geometry floors at all seeds support the contact-configuration hypothesis.

parameters.descent_dofs: every non-root DOF row (actuated and passive); the six free-root DOF rows are held fixed
parameters.objective: passive-subsystem minimum scaled balance error on the saved contact map, tendon map and friction; only the bias target is recomputed at the trial pose
parameters.descent_rule: deterministic cyclic coordinate descent in row order; per-DOF step h_rel*(joint range), h_rel starts at 0.25 and halves after any sweep without improvement
parameters.verification: replay of saved-input LPs in the same SciPy/HiGHS family; no independent physics or biological check
parameters.scope: Static witness generation under declared approximations; certification re-derives contacts but claims no dynamic hold, standing, walking or biological result
